title: Former LDWF secretary sentenced to prison for conspiring to take illegal kickbacks | Crime | hannapub.com
text:
Former secretary of the state Department of Wildlife and Fisheries (LDWF) Jack Montoucet, 78, was sentenced to 27 months in federal prison on June 30 for conspiring to defraud the United States by soliciting and accepting kickbacks in return for awarding a state contract.
